title: Smoother online play, a game that runs on more phones, and clearer matches from the first tap to the end screen
notes: Settings › Online › Show network stats: delay, ping, jitter, late turns and catch-ups on screen
New Performance graphics preset for older phones
Every graphics preset draws much less
Quick match on the main menu: one tap starts Three Realms against easy bots with your last immortal
Every mode card says Beginner, Standard or Advanced next to its length
Your first real match after the lesson gives four short hints at the right moments: lanes, last hits, pagodas and the river boss
"?" buttons explain last hits, lanes, objectives, ability haste, ranked placement, bots and the grade
Greyed-out buttons say why when you tap them, for example "Need 650 more gold" or that a lane is full
Ranked: the rating change is explained in words, with your placement progress
